hypothesis: With only the clarified query_clickhouse description, frozen local Qwen produces a first-response validator-compliant query with exact rows for every frozen blocker-rate case.
interpretation_boundary: Passing supports one M0.8 bounded Hermes workflow using the same description. It does not establish general SQL reliability, Hermes reliability, architecture superiority, or M1 readiness.

intervention.changed_behavior: The model-visible query_clickhouse description explicitly states that agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items is the only approved table and SQL must reference that exact fully qualified name.

retry_policy: one scheduled model call per case; zero retries, repair, or normalization

study.acceptance: One first-response query_clickhouse call; non-empty unedited SQL; unchanged validator acceptance; successful execution; exact expected rows.

cases.user_prompt: Which team has the highest blocker rate in the delivery dataset? Use the available analytics tool and return fields team and blocked_pct, with blocked_pct rounded to one decimal place.
